displayDff: original source dF/F; no event baseline subtraction
peakDetector: Standard plotting_ves041.m findpeaks on original dF/F
rotationDisplay: absolute yaw speed in deg/s; signed yaw retained in MAT
colorLimits: Full finite dF/F range shared across heat-on/off within each trial
eventWindowValidity: full window must have finite dF/F, forward, yaw and saved valid behavior, with no time gaps
individualFigureLayout: 4 rows x 8 columns: peaks; slowdowns; slowdowns without/with turns; rotation peaks below/above 1 mm/s forward drop; speed-ups without/with turns
rotationDetector: Absolute yaw after 0.12 s Gaussian smoothing; height >=20 deg/s, prominence >=max(20,2*1.4826*MAD(abs(yaw)-5 s moving median)), spacing >=1.5 s
rotationForwardSplit: 0.25 s median-smoothed forward; median(-0.75:-0.25 s) minus median(+0.25:+0.75 s), threshold 1 mm/s
turnAngleIntegration: Accumulated absolute 0.25-second median-smoothed yaw over exact interval endpoints; threshold 15 degrees
heatClassification: Heat state at event alignment sample; complete windows may cross transitions, recorded in events.csv
legacyYawUnits: Virmen radians/s converted to degrees/s; original saved gain retained
cohort: All located heat trials, regardless of prior behavior quality
shortValidSegments: Skip rotation-detector segments shorter than 5 s; no complete -2:+3 s window can fit
nativeLegacyFallback: 20260427-5: processed imaging MAT dq(1).heat >0.05 V; imaging-aligned physical ball velocities
completion: 23 complete trials; 20260424-2 awaiting ROI extraction by user request
